subject: mathematics
content: In a multiple-choice question there are four alternative answers, of which one or more are correct. A candidate will get marks in the question only if he ticks the correct answers. The candidate decides to tick the answers at random, If he is allowed upto three chances to answer the questions, find the probability that he will get marks in the questions.
